pages.en:
To Secretary General
for Mayor Chen

In accordance with the attached order from the Shanghai
City Government dated 21-12-44 investigations revealed the
the following:-

Miss Inge Wolff was born on 14-7-1920 in Berlin Germany.
Her father Doctor Julius Wolff dental-surgeon is a Jew.
Her mother Margarettu Wolff is German Aryan.

Inge Wolff arrived in Shanghai with her parents in May 1939
She is in possession of German passport No. 111/R/319/38 issued
on 16-12-38 in Berlin valid till 16-12-43 and upon arrival here
in 1939 prolonged by the local German Consulate till 2-4-1943.
In Shanghai She became adopted with Doctor Ting Tsung Chung
and his wife, who on 1-9-1944 have adopted her as per the attached
Certificate. Questioned she stated that she became adopted in
order to obtain Chinese Citizenship as she intended to marry a
Chinese, who did not wish to marry her should she not a Chinese
Citizen. Having obtained the adoption Certificate, she failed to
prolong her German passport and on 20-8-44 made an application to
the Nanking Government for Chinese Citizenship. On 17-11-44 she
received a reply from the Ministry of Home Affairs advising her to
forward the application through Shanghai City Government. She made
the application as instructed but so far received no reply.

Her father and mother, being Refugees are residing at the
Designated Area (503 Ward Road) but she resides at 313/301 Route
Vallon, her application for permit to rent the above Apartment,
having been approved by Mr. Kubota Director for the Affairs of
Stateless Refugees, on 7-10-1943.

Having obtained the adoption Certificate, and not yet the Chinese
Citizenship she visited the Chinese Pao Chia Office at Loukawei
Police Stations, where her German Resident Certificate was exchanged
for Chinese Resident Certificate No. 284579, which she now possesses.

This Resident Certificate was issued without any instructions from
the Pao Chia Headquarters, which is wrong procedure and she having
not obtained Chinese Citizenship has no right to possess Chinese Resi-
dent Certificate.
pages.zh:
致陈市长
转秘书长

根据随附的上海市政府1944年12月21日命令，经调查查明如下情况：

英格·沃尔夫（Inge Wolff）小姐于1920年7月14日出生于德国柏林。其父朱利叶斯·沃尔夫（Julius Wolff）博士为牙科医生，系犹太人。其母玛格丽特·沃尔夫（Margarettu Wolff）为德意志雅利安人。

英格·沃尔夫于1939年5月随父母抵达上海。她持有1938年12月16日在柏林签发的德国护照，号码为111/R/319/38，有效期至1943年12月16日；1939年抵沪后，经当地德国领事馆将有效期延长至1943年4月2日。在上海期间，她被丁宗钟（Ting Tsung Chung）博士及其妻子收养，二人已于1944年9月1日依照随附证书办理收养手续。经讯问，她陈述称，办理收养是为了取得中国国籍，因其打算与一名中国人结婚，而该男子表示若她非中国公民则不愿与其成婚。在取得收养证书后，她未延长其德国护照，并于1944年8月20日向南京政府申请加入中国国籍。1944年11月17日，她收到内政部复函，指示其通过上海市政府转呈申请。她已按指示提出申请，但迄今未获回复。

其父母身为难民，现居住于指定区域（华德路503号），但她本人居住在法隆路（Route Vallon）313/301号；其租用上述公寓的许可申请，已于1943年10月7日获无国籍难民事务局局长久保田（Kubota）先生批准。

她在取得收养证书但尚未获得中国国籍的情况下，前往卢家湾警察分局的中国保甲办事处，将其德国居留证换领为中国居留证，号码为284579，该证现由她持有。

此居留证的签发未经过保甲总处的任何指令，程序错误；且因她尚未取得中国国籍，无权持有中国居留证。

pages.en:
SHANGHAI
Order from the Shanghai City Government
Dated December 9, 1944.
To Police Bureau,
A petition has been received from Ting Tsung Chung
stating that he has adopted a German female named Ting Gee
Hwa as daughter and that the adoption has been certified
by the Shanghai District Court. He now requests this
City Government to forward his application to the Ministry
of Home Affairs for the issue of a naturalization certificate
to his adopted daughter.
The Police Bureau is hereby instructed to
investigate and report. Attached is a photographic copy
of the adoption certificate which should be returned to this
City Government after the completion of the investigation.
Secretary General Woo
for Mayor Chen.
------
pages.zh:
上海
上海市政府命令
日期：1944年12月9日。
致警察局，
接获丁宗钟呈文，称其已收养一名名为丁吉华（Ting Gee Hwa）的德国女子为女，且该收养关系已经上海地方法院认证。现请求本市政府将其申请转呈内政部，以便向其养女签发归化证书。
兹指令警察局进行调查并具报。随附收养证书照片副本一份，调查完毕后应退回本市政府。
吴秘书长
代陈市长。
------

pages.en:
Adoption Certificate

Dated August 1, 1943.

This is to certify that the undersigned
(Ting Tsung Chung and Ting Zien King Kong) have
adopted German female Inge Wolff as daughter and have
her renamed Ting Gee Hwa, on introduction by Doctor Terni.

(Signed & sealed) Ting Tsung Chung
Ting Zien King Kong.

(Adopted daughter) Ting Gee Hwa
(Inge Wolff)

(Introducers) Doctor Terni.
Van Gee Chong.

Certified by Judge Loh Gee, Shanghai
District Court, on 8.9.43.
pages.zh:
收养证书

日期：1943年8月1日。

兹证明下述签署人
（丁宗钟及丁先敬恭（Ting Zien King Kong））
经特尔尼（Terni）医生介绍，已收养德国女子英格·沃尔夫（Inge Wolff）为女，
并将其更名为丁吉华（Ting Gee Hwa）。

（签名并盖章）丁宗钟
丁先敬恭。

（养女）丁吉华
（英格·沃尔夫）

（介绍人）特尔尼（Terni）医生。
范吉忠（Van Gee Chong）。

由上海地方法院罗基（Loh Gee）法官于1943年9月8日认证。
